description: TRY_TO_BINARY(expr [, format]) is the non-throwing TO_BINARY: it decodes HEX by default and BASE64 on request, and answers NULL instead of erroring on undecodable input. The leniency has a boundary: TRY_TO_* is TRY_CAST under the hood and needs a VARCHAR source, so an UNTYPED NULL errors (live-verified: Function TRY_CAST cannot be used with arguments of types NULL and BINARY) while NULL::VARCHAR converts to NULL. Converted 1:1 from functions/TryToBinaryTest (now retired).
